Title: New Azure Cosmos DB throughput calculator

Body.Content:
To help customers fine-tune their Azure Cosmos DB throughput estimations, we've launched a web-based tool to help estimate the request unit requirements for typical operations, including document creates, reads, and deletes. 

For more information about Azure Cosmos DB, visit the Azure Cosmos DB page.
